fb_text:
The client swore nobody showed up last Tuesday.

That used to mean an argument. Maybe a lost account. Their word against your guy's, and you're not even sure yourself because you weren't there.

Now it's a 30-second conversation.

Your tech sent a voice note right after the visit — like he does after every stop. The log's timestamped. Gate code used, issue found, work done, all of it.

"Here's the record from 2:14 PM Tuesday." Dispute over.

No apps. No forms. Your crew talks to it like they already text. Everything becomes a timestamped record you can actually pull up when it matters.

Try the 60-second demo — no credit card:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
